title: Thelia Page Module before 2.0.4 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to…
description: The Thelia Page Module versions prior to 2.0.4 contain a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability. This flaw allows remote attackers to delete page tags, documents, and images by exploiting back-office delete routes that lack CSRF tokens and permission checks. Attackers can trick logged-in administrators into visiting crafted GET requests that sequentially delete TheliaLibrary images and associated files across pages, products, and categories.
